runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 19:37 sweep across 12 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, PracaZaRohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. PracaZaRohom resurfaced AGEL Lab and BKIS mirrors already known from stronger/earlier evidence. Brigada.sk surfaced a Bratislava promoter role but it is restricted to active students aged 20-25 and was rejected for eligibility. Upwork returned several fresh WooCommerce/WordPress jobs; the strongest new setup role is worldwide remote at 20-25 USD/h but has 50+ proposals and expects an experienced WordPress/WooCommerce/Elementor developer, so no LIVE promotion. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Eligibility gate before ranking
developmentChanges.reason: Apply hard eligibility checks such as student-only, age-limited, mandatory certification or contract-status constraints before scoring/ranking. This prevents locally valid but unusable jobs from consuming review time or appearing as attractive false positives.

developmentChanges.title: Mirror resurface counter
developmentChanges.reason: Track how often the same underlying vacancy reappears across mirrors and aggregators without treating it as new discovery. This improves source-success analytics and prevents repeated alerts while still using mirror recurrence as weak evidence that a vacancy remains active.
